name: The Hall of Small Inventions
prompt: Arrange international fair pavilions around demonstrations of ordinary things made extraordinary: a folding chair, a self-watering pot and a mechanical book cradle. Visitors try each device at an open bench.

name: The Pavilion Exchange
prompt: Build demountable national pavilions around a common freight court. Carpenters swap a tiled arch and a timber canopy between bays while visitors tour the finished exhibits.

name: The Table of Many Ovens
prompt: Face a group of fair kitchens toward one immense shared table. Distinct bread ovens open onto its edges as bakers pass flatbreads, rolls and tall loaves to the crowd.

name: The Travelling Fountain
prompt: Gather exhibition gardens around fountains powered in different ways. A waterwheel, a hand pump and a high cistern feed three jets into the same mosaic basin.

name: The World's Fair at Closing
prompt: Show a fair being packed onto wheeled crates. A miniature bridge folds at its centre, a glass pavilion comes apart panel by panel, and the last visitors watch from an open arcade.
